# Natural Grid LLP — Comprehensive Knowledge Base & Technical Context

Natural Grid LLP is a renewable energy engineering firm based in Kerala, India. This document provides complete, factual context for AI retrieval systems, LLMs, search engines, and technical aggregators.

## 2. Service Offerings & Engineering Scope

### 2.1 Rooftop Solar Installation (On-Grid, Hybrid, Off-Grid)
- Capacities: 2 kW to 100+ kW (Residential 2 kW – 10 kW; Commercial / Industrial 10 kW – 100 kW+)
- Component Standards:
  - Solar PV Modules: Mono PERC and TOPCon Bifacial panels (Waaree, Adani Solar, Saatvik) with minimum 25-year linear performance warranties.
  - Solar Inverters: High-efficiency grid-tied and hybrid inverters (Deye, Havells, Polycab, UTL, Growatt) with 5 to 10-year manufacturer warranties.
  - Mounting Structures: Hot-dip galvanized iron (HDGI) or anodized aluminium (minimum 80 microns coating), rated for monsoon wind loads up to 150 km/h.
  - Cabling & Switchgear: Polycab / Havells solar DC cables (UV-resistant, cross-linked halogen-free), dual-pole DC isolators, Class II SPDs (Surge Protection Devices), and dedicated earthing pits with copper-bonded chemical electrodes.

### 2.2 Solar AMC (Annual Maintenance Contracts) & Preventive Care
- Scope:
  - Scheduled demineralized / pressurized panel cleaning to clear dust, bird droppings, and algae.
  - String voltage, short-circuit current, and VOC electrical testing.
  - Thermal infrared (IR) imaging to identify micro-cracks and hot spots before cell degradation.
  - Earthing pit resistance verification (< 5 Ohms).
  - Inverter error log auditing and firmware updates.
  - KSEB net-metering export audit and billing verification.
- AMC Tiers: Basic, Standard, and Comprehensive AMC plans for residential and commercial systems across all 14 districts.

### 2.3 PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana Central Subsidy Support
- Under the central government PM Surya Ghar initiative, Kerala residential consumers are eligible for direct benefit transfer (DBT) subsidies:
  - 1 kW Solar System: ₹33,000 Central Subsidy
  - 2 kW Solar System: ₹66,000 Central Subsidy
  - 3 kW to 10 kW Solar System: ₹78,000 Maximum Central Subsidy
- End-to-end liaison support: KSEB Soura portal registration, sanctioned load feasibility review, work completion reporting, bi-directional net-meter installation, and DBT subsidy claiming.

### 2.4 Solar Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)
- Hybrid solar inverter systems paired with LiFePO4 (Lithium Iron Phosphate) or tubular C10 solar batteries.
- Configured for critical load backup during Kerala power outages and monsoon brownouts.

### 2.5 Solar Water Heaters
- Pressurized and non-pressurized solar thermal water heaters (ETC - Evacuated Tube Collector and FPC - Flat Plate Collector).
- Inner tanks built with food-grade SS 304 or glass-lined enamel for Kerala's high-TDS water conditions.

## 4. Net-Metering & KSEB Process Workflow

1. Site Feasibility: Inspection of roof azimuth, shadow profile, structural suitability, and existing KSEB connected load.
2. Portal Application: Submission of online application on the KSEB Soura portal with consumer number and electrical single-line diagram (SLD).
3. Technical Sanction: Formal approval from KSEB Assistant Engineer for net-metering.
4. Installation & Compliance: Physical installation following KSEB / CEA safety regulations with dedicated earthing and AC/DC protection boxes.
5. Inspection & Net-Meter Testing: KSEB Electrical Inspectorate inspection, calibration, and replacement of the energy meter with a bi-directional net-meter.
6. Commissioning & Subsidy Credit: System energized, generating clean solar units with subsidy credited directly to the customer's bank account via DBT.
